instruction:
You are an ITS communications engineer checking a task-owned synthetic SSC-13 remote backup communications package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. External RF, fibre, ITS, and battery tools shape the workflow context only; they are not extra data sources for this instance.

## Scene

- Product: `SSC-13-LH-04`
- Device inventory: `DEV-13-INV-04`
- RF link sheet: `RF-13-LINK-04`
- Fibre topology: `FIB-13-TOPO-04`
- Bandwidth table: `BW-13-TABLE-04`
- Battery data sheet: `PWR-13-BAT-04`
- Communications resilience memo: `MEMO-13-REMOTE-04`

All checks use the same remote device inventory, RF/fibre topology, bandwidth table, PoE loads, and backup-power basis.

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| RF transmit power | {{ rf_tx_power_dbm }} dBm |
| RF transmit/receive gain | {{ rf_tx_gain_db }} dB / {{ rf_rx_gain_db }} dB |
| RF path and misc loss | {{ rf_path_loss_db }} dB / {{ rf_misc_loss_db }} dB |
| Receiver sensitivity | {{ rf_receiver_sensitivity_dbm }} dBm |
| Fibre length and attenuation | {{ fibre_length_km }} km at {{ fibre_loss_db_per_km }} dB/km |
| Connector count/loss | {{ connector_count }} at {{ connector_loss_db }} dB |
| Splice count/loss | {{ splice_count }} at {{ splice_loss_db }} dB |
| Reserve loss and budget | {{ reserve_loss_db }} dB / {{ fibre_budget_db }} dB |
| Network loads | CCTV {{ cctv_network_mbps }} Mbps, VMS {{ vms_network_mbps }} Mbps, sensor {{ sensor_network_mbps }} Mbps, controller {{ controller_network_mbps }} Mbps |
| Network overhead and capacity | {{ network_overhead_factor }} / {{ backhaul_capacity_mbps }} Mbps |
| PoE loads | {{ camera_count }} cameras at {{ camera_poe_w }} W, radio {{ radio_poe_w }} W, VMS {{ vms_poe_w }} W, sensor {{ sensor_poe_w }} W |
| PoE budget | {{ poe_budget_w }} W |
| Backup load/autonomy | {{ backup_load_w }} W for {{ autonomy_h }} h |
| Inverter efficiency/DOD/battery | {{ inverter_efficiency }}, {{ allowable_depth_of_discharge }}, {{ battery_capacity_kwh }} kWh |

## Output Format

Write a compact communications resilience memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "rf_received_power_dbm": <numeric_value>,
  "rf_fade_margin_db": <numeric_value>,
  "fibre_loss_db": <numeric_value>,
  "fibre_margin_db": <numeric_value>,
  "network_load_mbps": <numeric_value>,
  "network_headroom_mbps": <numeric_value>,
  "poe_load_w": <numeric_value>,
  "poe_headroom_w": <numeric_value>,
  "battery_required_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "battery_margin_kwh": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```
paramsToml:
# ABOUTME: Defines the SSC-13 remote ITS backup communications template.
# ABOUTME: Pins one task-owned remote communications source pack and expected outputs.

[meta]
name = "remote-its-backup-communications-package"
description = "SSC-13 remote ITS RF, fibre, bandwidth, PoE, and battery checks"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound remote ITS communications resilience metrics from a deterministic SSC-13 task-owned source pack. The template combines RF link budget, fibre loss, bandwidth, PoE load, and battery autonomy."
discipline = "electrical"
category = "its-communications"
standards = ["RF link budget workflow", "fibre link loss budget", "ITS bandwidth review", "battery autonomy review"]
tags = ["electrical", "its", "communications", "rf", "fibre", "poe", "battery", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.rf_tx_power_dbm]
type = "float"
unit = "dBm"
description = "RF-13-LINK-04 transmit power"
min = 24.0
max = 24.0

[params.rf_tx_gain_db]
type = "float"
unit = "dB"
description = "RF-13-LINK-04 transmit antenna gain"
min = 16.0
max = 16.0

[params.rf_rx_gain_db]
type = "float"
unit = "dB"
description = "RF-13-LINK-04 receive antenna gain"
min = 14.0
max = 14.0

[params.rf_path_loss_db]
type = "float"
unit = "dB"
description = "RF-13-LINK-04 path loss"
min = 112.0
max = 112.0

[params.rf_misc_loss_db]
type = "float"
unit = "dB"
description = "RF-13-LINK-04 miscellaneous RF losses"
min = 3.0
max = 3.0

[params.rf_receiver_sensitivity_dbm]
type = "float"
unit = "dBm"
description = "RF-13-LINK-04 receiver sensitivity"
min = -82.0
max = -82.0

[params.fibre_length_km]
type = "float"
unit = "km"
description = "FIB-13-TOPO-04 fibre length"
min = 2.4
max = 2.4

[params.fibre_loss_db_per_km]
type = "float"
unit = "dB/km"
description = "FIB-13-TOPO-04 fibre attenuation"
min = 0.35
max = 0.35

[params.connector_count]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "FIB-13-TOPO-04 connector count"
min = 2.0
max = 2.0

[params.connector_loss_db]
type = "float"
unit = "dB"
description = "FIB-13-TOPO-04 loss per connector"
min = 0.5
max = 0.5

[params.splice_count]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "FIB-13-TOPO-04 splice count"
min = 4.0
max = 4.0

[params.splice_loss_db]
type = "float"
unit = "dB"
description = "FIB-13-TOPO-04 loss per splice"
min = 0.1
max = 0.1

[params.reserve_loss_db]
type = "float"
unit = "dB"
description = "FIB-13-TOPO-04 reserve loss allowance"
min = 1.0
max = 1.0

[params.fibre_budget_db]
type = "float"
unit = "dB"
description = "FIB-13-TOPO-04 optical loss budget"
min = 18.0
max = 18.0

[params.cctv_network_mbps]
type = "float"
unit = "Mbps"
description = "BW-13-TABLE-04 CCTV network load"
min = 8.0
max = 8.0

[params.vms_network_mbps]
type = "float"
unit = "Mbps"
description = "BW-13-TABLE-04 VMS network load"
min = 1.5
max = 1.5

[params.sensor_network_mbps]
type = "float"
unit = "Mbps"
description = "BW-13-TABLE-04 sensor network load"
min = 0.5
max = 0.5

[params.controller_network_mbps]
type = "float"
unit = "Mbps"
description = "BW-13-TABLE-04 controller network load"
min = 0.8
max = 0.8

[params.network_overhead_factor]
type = "float"
description = "BW-13-TABLE-04 network overhead factor"
min = 1.25
max = 1.25

[params.backhaul_capacity_mbps]
type = "float"
unit = "Mbps"
description = "BW-13-TABLE-04 backhaul capacity"
min = 30.0
max = 30.0

[params.camera_count]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "DEV-13-INV-04 camera count"
min = 2.0
max = 2.0

[params.camera_poe_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "DEV-13-INV-04 PoE load per camera"
min = 14.0
max = 14.0

[params.radio_poe_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "DEV-13-INV-04 radio PoE load"
min = 8.0
max = 8.0

[params.vms_poe_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "DEV-13-INV-04 VMS communications PoE load"
min = 10.0
max = 10.0

[params.sensor_poe_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "DEV-13-INV-04 sensor PoE load"
min = 5.0
max = 5.0

[params.poe_budget_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "DEV-13-INV-04 PoE budget"
min = 90.0
max = 90.0

[params.backup_load_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "PWR-13-BAT-04 backup load"
min = 140.0
max = 140.0

[params.autonomy_h]
type = "float"
unit = "h"
description = "PWR-13-BAT-04 autonomy"
min = 12.0
max = 12.0

[params.inverter_efficiency]
type = "float"
description = "PWR-13-BAT-04 inverter efficiency"
min = 0.85
max = 0.85

[params.allowable_depth_of_discharge]
type = "float"
description = "PWR-13-BAT-04 allowable depth of discharge"
min = 0.80
max = 0.80

[params.battery_capacity_kwh]
type = "float"
unit = "kWh"
description = "PWR-13-BAT-04 battery capacity"
min = 3.2
max = 3.2

[outputs.rf_received_power_dbm]
description = "Received RF power at the remote device"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.rf_fade_margin_db]
description = "Received RF power minus receiver sensitivity"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.fibre_loss_db]
description = "Fibre link loss"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.fibre_margin_db]
description = "Fibre budget minus loss"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.network_load_mbps]
description = "Network load including overhead"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.network_headroom_mbps]
description = "Backhaul capacity minus network load"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.poe_load_w]
description = "Total PoE load"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.poe_headroom_w]
description = "PoE budget minus load"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.battery_required_kwh]
description = "Battery energy required for autonomy"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.battery_margin_kwh]
description = "Installed battery capacity minus required capacity"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "1.0 when communications and backup checks pass"
tolerance = 0.001

[archetypes.ssc13_remote_its_case]
description = "Remote ITS backup communications case"
site_contexts = ["ssc13-remote-its"]

[difficulty.easy]
description = "All source-pack values given for the SSC-13 remote ITS package"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["ssc13_remote_its_case"]

[difficulty.medium]
description = "All source-pack values given for the SSC-13 remote ITS package"
visibility = "all_given"
archetypes = ["ssc13_remote_its_case"]
